_README: Gambling/speculation validation roster. One row per KNOWN dated outcome. Copy to kp_gambling_validation.json and replace with REAL cases. The gate needs >= 20 real cases at >= 70% (pre-registered config). Placeholder rows (id contains 'example'/'template', or known_outcome not yes/no) are ignored.

cases.notes: example row — yes = the bet/session WON (+), no = it LOST (-)
